description: This figure of eight walk explores the woodland, countryside and river valley around Stanford Dingley in Berkshire. The eastern secton visits neighbouring Bradfield while the western section includes waymarked trails along the River Pang. The route runs for about 9.5 miles and involves some small climbs with fine views of the River Pang valley from the high points. Along the way there are also several peaceful woodland trails through Greathouse Wood and Highwood Copse. You can continue your walking in the area by visiting the nearby Bucklebury Common which is another popular local walking spot.

details.subtitle: Pubs/Cafes
details.content: The Old Boot is a fine place to enjoy some post walk refreshments. The 18th century Inn offers two dining experiences, traditional British pub classics in the pub, and a new garden dining experience in the summer in heated teepees. They also have a lovely dog-friendly garden with great views. You can find them at postcode RG7 6LT.
